title: Which country speaks it officially: Americas
intro: Find a country in the Americas that uses each language officially.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Aymara as an official language?
questions.explain: Aymara is an official language of Bolivia (Plurinational State of).

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Spanish as an official language?
questions.explain: Spanish is an official language of Ecuador.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Haitian as an official language?
questions.explain: Haitian is an official language of Haiti.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Dutch as an official language?
questions.explain: Dutch is an official language of Suriname.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has French as an official language?
questions.explain: French is an official language of Haiti.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Portuguese as an official language?
questions.explain: Portuguese is an official language of Brazil.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Guarani as an official language?
questions.explain: Guarani is an official language of Paraguay.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Quechua as an official language?
questions.explain: Quechua is an official language of Peru.
